name: Open Source Village 2027
tagline: A pop-up village for the open source community, alongside FOSDEM.
description: Twelve days of coworking, workshops, talks and evening gatherings at the Commons Hub, about 20 minutes from FOSDEM by bus or bike. Up to 100 people a day, on application.
location: Commons Hub Brussels, Rue de la Madeleine 51, 1000 Brussels
